title: Alianzas y conflictos
goal: Read how decentralized peoples such as the Mapuche resisted the Spanish, meet the interpreter who served Cortés, and learn what status Tlaxcala received for its help.

items: Contrast the centralized empires of Tenochtitlan and Cuzco with the decentralized peoples who resisted.
Describe who La Malinche was and why she mattered to Cortés.
Describe how the Mapuche resisted Valdivia, from Tucapel (1553) to Curalaba (1598).
Describe the privilege Tlaxcala negotiated after Tenochtitlan fell.
Use an opening gerund to describe the method or condition behind an action.
